title: Procurement of 1,500,000 Bbls of Gasoline 92 Unl during the period from 2025 09 15 to 2026 03 14
decision_details: Bids have been invited to meet the requirement of 1,500,000 Bbls +/-5% of Gasoline 92 Unl for a period of six (06) months from 2025 09 15 to 2026 03 14, from the suppliers registered of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation. Eight (08) suppliers have submitted bids for the purpose. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the term contract for the supply of 1,500,000 Bbls +/-5% of Gasoline 92 Unl (05 shipments of 300,000Bbls +/-5% each) to M/s. Aditya Birla Global Trading (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., Singapore, based on the recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
